Examples.Title: Deletes an Agent.
Examples.Code:
### Deletes an Agent.
# @name DeleteAgent
DELETE {{host}}/v1beta/agents/{{agentsId}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# default
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Gets a specific Agent.
Examples.Code:
### Gets a specific Agent.
# @name GetAgent
GET {{host}}/v1beta/agents/{{agentsId}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# default
# Description: Successful operation

Examples.Title: Lists all Agents.
Examples.Code:
### Lists all Agents.
# @name ListAgents
GET {{host}}/v1beta/agents?page_size={{page_size}}&page_token={{page_token}}&parent={{parent}}
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# default
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Canceling an interaction
Examples.Description: Cancels an interaction by id. This only applies to background interactions that are still running.
Examples.Code:
### Canceling an interaction
# @name cancelInteractionById
POST {{host}}/v1beta/interactions/{{id}}/cancel
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful operation
# Content-Type: application/json
# 4XX
# Description: Error cancelling interaction
# Content-Type: application/json
# 5XX
# Description: Error cancelling interaction
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Creating an interaction
Retrieving an interaction
Examples.Description: Retrieves the full details of a single interaction based on its `Interaction.id`.
Examples.Code:
### Retrieving an interaction
# @name getInteractionById
GET {{host}}/v1beta/interactions/{{id}}?last_event_id={{last_event_id}}&stream=false
x-goog-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful retrieval of the interaction.
# Content-Type: application/json, text/event-stream
# 4XX
# Description: Error getting interaction
# Content-Type: application/json
# 5XX
# Description: Error getting interaction
# Content-Type: application/json
